intent: Drives the running app in a real browser (localhost-only, never disabling the content-security stack), reproduces every bug with exact steps, writes a red-first regression test per bug, blocks ship on a V1 functional bug, and records a 05-qa.md artifact.

dimensions.name: browser-driven
dimensions.criterion: Drives the running application in a real browser via the browse tool.

dimensions.name: localhost-and-security
dimensions.criterion: Localhost-only by default; never disables the browser content-security stack.

dimensions.name: reproduce-first
dimensions.criterion: Every bug has exact reproduction steps; an unreproducible report is a note.

dimensions.name: regression-test
dimensions.criterion: Each reproducible bug gets a red-first regression test.

dimensions.name: blocking-gate
dimensions.criterion: A V1-flow functional bug is a blocking finding before /ship.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the bug list as the 05-qa.md run artifact (seq 5, not 4 which is review).
